src: APPSC Forest Section Officer General Studies & Mental Abilit

s: The power factor in a transformer
answer: Depends on power factor of load
src: APPSC AEE Electrical Engineering Screening Test General Stud
x: A transformer has no power factor of its own; the primary power factor follows the power factor of the load connected to it.

s: The maximum efficiency of a distribution transformer is
src: APPSC AEE Electrical Engineering Screening Test General Stud
x: Distribution transformers run lightly loaded most of the day, so they are designed for maximum efficiency at about 50% of full load (power transformers near full load).

s: Lower power factor of a DG set demands
src: APPSC AEE Electrical Engineering Screening Test General Stud
x: A low power factor means more lagging reactive current, so the DG set's alternator needs higher field excitation current.

s: The starting current value of a DG set should not exceed what % of full load capacity of the DG set?
src: APPSC AEE Electrical Engineering Screening Test General Stud
x: The printed answer is 200%: the motor starting current drawn from a DG set should not exceed about twice its full-load current, or the voltage dips badly.

s: Auxiliary power consumption of a DG set at full load in its operating capacity is about
src: APPSC AEE Electrical Engineering Screening Test General Stud
x: A diesel-generator set's own auxiliary consumption at full load is small, about 1-2% of its output (engineering item, not nuclear).

s: Maximum permissible earth resistance for buildings is
src: APPSC AEE Electrical Engineering Screening Test General Stud

s: The rating required for a DG set with 500 kW connected load and with diversity factor of 1.5, 80% loading and 0.8 power factor is
src: APPSC AEE Electrical Engineering Screening Test General Stud
x: Maximum demand = 500 kW ÷ 1.5 = 333 kW. At 80% loading the rating = 333 ÷ 0.8 = 417 kW, and at 0.8 pf that is 417 ÷ 0.8 ≈ 520 kVA.

src: APPSC Assistant Director of Economics, Assistant Commissione

src: APPSC Forest Beat Officer & Assistant Beat Officer General S

src: APPSC Forest Beat Officer & Assistant Beat Officer General S

s: Forests and lakes are best classified as examples of:
src: APPSC Deputy Executive Information Engineers & Inspector of
x: Forests and lakes are natural ecosystems (terrestrial and aquatic); croplands and gardens are man-made ones.

s: A new National Air Quality Index (AQI) launched in October 2014 to disseminate the information on air quality in an easily understandable form for the general public is based on ____ pollutants which are measured up to 24-hourly averaging period.
src: APPSC Forest Section Officer General Studies & Mental Abilit
x: The National AQI (launched October 2014 / April 2015) uses 8 pollutants: PM10, PM2.5, NO2, SO2, CO, O3, NH3 and Pb, measured up to 24-hour averages.

s: Which among the following is not a primary pollutant?
src: APPSC Assistant Director of Economics, Assistant Commissione
x: Ozone at ground level is a secondary pollutant formed from NOx and hydrocarbons in sunlight, so it is not a primary pollutant.

s: The term ‘pH’ denotes
answer: Acidity and basicity of the Solution
src: APPSC Executive Officer Grade-III in A.P. Endowments Sub-Service Screening Test (Notification 24/2021), Section A (General Studies), held 24-07-2022 · Q26
x: pH is the negative logarithm of hydrogen-ion concentration and tells how acidic or basic a solution is.

s: Which of the following is not correctly matched ?

s: Acid rains occur when atmosphere is heavily polluted with:
src: APPSC Forest Range Officer Screening Test (2018 recruitment), held 28-05-2019 · Q16

s: Eutrophication is a

src: APPSC Group-III Mains Panchayat Secretary (Grade-IV) Paper-I

s: The non-biotic pollutant of underground water is
src: APPSC Forest Beat Officer & Assistant Beat Officer Screening Test 2019 (Notification 07/2019, booklet OBF/444), held 16-06-2019 · Q111
x: Arsenic is a chemical (non-living) contaminant of groundwater.

src: APPSC Forest Beat Officer & Assistant Beat Officer Screening Test 2019 (Notification 07/2019, booklet OBF/444), held 16-06-2019 · Q115

s: Eutrophication of lakes is caused by
src: APPSC Forest Range Officer Screening Test (2018 recruitment), held 28-05-2019 · Q17

s: Which of the following has pH value 7?

s: Green Muffler is

x: A green muffler is 4–5 rows of trees and shrubs planted along roads and near noisy places to absorb noise.

x: Crackers louder than 125 dB(AI) or 145 dB(C)pk at 4 m from the point of bursting may not be made, sold or used (EP Rules standard, amended 2006).

src: APPSC Forest Range Officer Screening Test (2018 recruitment), held 28-05-2019 · Q53

src: APPSC Forest Range Officer Screening Test (2018 recruitment), held 28-05-2019 · Q55

s: How many states faced Rs.1 crore fine for missing deadline for plan on plastic disposal?
